# Set-up
```{r}

set.seed(42)

cran_packages <- c("knitr", "readxl", "tidyverse", "here", "boot")

missing_cran <- setdiff(cran_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran)
}

require(knitr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(boot)

# set default code chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F, message = F)

# suppress warnings about grouping
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = F)

# the sourced experiment files are purled, so their unnamed chunks collide
# with this file's when knitting
options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")
```

# Data

```{r}
source_rmd <- function(rmd_path) {
  tmp_r <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  knitr::purl(rmd_path, output = tmp_r, quiet = TRUE)
  sys.source(tmp_r, envir = globalenv())
}

source_rmd(here("code", "analyses", "e1.Rmd"))
source_rmd(here("code", "analyses", "e2a.Rmd"))
```

# Experiment 1: Additional Analyses

## Original vs. Replication Correlations

```{r}

df.e1_orig_full_summary <- full_join(df.e1_difficulty_summary,
          full_join(df.e1_buildtask_summary, df.e1_time_summary))

# Original data: diff/time vs. build, and diff vs. time
cor.test(df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_diff, df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_build)
cor.test(df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_time, df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_build)
cor.test(df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_diff, df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_time)

df.e1_rep_full_summary <- full_join(df.e1_rep_diff_summary,
          full_join(df.e1_rep_time_summary, df.e1_buildtask_summary))

# Replication data compared to itself, and to build
cor.test(df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_diff, df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_build)
cor.test(df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_time, df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_build)
cor.test(df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_diff, df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_time)

```

## Bootstrapped Correlation Differences (Original Data Only)

```{r}

# the per-trial means from e1.Rmd, z-scored across the 50 structures
df.e1_difficulty_forboot <- df.e1_difficulty_summary |>
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(base::scale(mean_diff)),
         study = "Difficulty") |>
  select(-mean_diff)

df.e1_time_forboot <- df.e1_time_summary |>
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(base::scale(mean_time)),
         study = "Time") |>
  select(-mean_time)

df.e1_forboot_wide <- full_join(df.e1_difficulty_forboot,
            full_join(df.e1_time_forboot, df.e1_build_forboot)) |>
  mutate(trial = paste(trial, easy_hard, sep = "_")) |>
  select(-easy_hard) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = mean)

boot_cor_BD <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_cor_BT <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_cor_DT <- numeric(n_boot)

boot_diff_BD_DT <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_diff_BD_BT <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_diff_BT_DT <- numeric(n_boot)

for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
  boot_sample <- df.e1_forboot_wide %>%
    sample_frac(size = 1, replace = TRUE)

  boot_cor_BD[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Build, boot_sample$Difficulty, use = "complete.obs")
  boot_cor_BT[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Build, boot_sample$Time, use = "complete.obs")
  boot_cor_DT[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Difficulty, boot_sample$Time, use = "complete.obs")

  boot_diff_BD_DT[i] <- boot_cor_BD[i] - boot_cor_DT[i]
  boot_diff_BD_BT[i] <- boot_cor_BD[i] - boot_cor_BT[i]
  boot_diff_BT_DT[i] <- boot_cor_BT[i] - boot_cor_DT[i]
}

#compute 95% CIs on differences; if CI excludes 0, correlations are reliably different
quantile(boot_diff_BD_DT, c(0.025, 0.975))
quantile(boot_diff_BD_BT, c(0.025, 0.975))
quantile(boot_diff_BT_DT, c(0.025, 0.975))

```

## Bootstrapped Correlation Differences (Replication Data Only)

```{r}

# the replication per-trial means from e1.Rmd, without the two trials that
# can't be modeled, z-scored across the 50 structures
df.e1_rep_diff_forboot <- df.e1_rep_diff_summary |>
  filter(!trial %in% c("10_Stability", "24_Stability")) |>

  mutate(mean = as.numeric(base::scale(mean_time)),
         study = "Time") |>
  select(-mean_time)

df.e1_rep_forboot_wide <- full_join(df.e1_rep_diff_forboot,
            full_join(df.e1_rep_time_forboot, df.e1_build_forboot)) |>
  mutate(trial = paste(trial, easy_hard, sep = "_")) |>
  select(-easy_hard) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = mean)

boot_cor_BD_rep <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_cor_BT_rep <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_cor_DT_rep <- numeric(n_boot)

boot_diff_BD_DT_rep <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_diff_BD_BT_rep <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_diff_BT_DT_rep <- numeric(n_boot)

for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
  boot_sample <- df.e1_rep_forboot_wide %>%
    sample_frac(size = 1, replace = TRUE)

  boot_cor_BD_rep[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Build, boot_sample$Difficulty, use = "complete.obs")
  boot_cor_BT_rep[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Build, boot_sample$Time, use = "complete.obs")
  boot_cor_DT_rep[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Difficulty, boot_sample$Time, use = "complete.obs")

  boot_diff_BD_DT_rep[i] <- boot_cor_BD_rep[i] - boot_cor_DT_rep[i]
  boot_diff_BD_BT_rep[i] <- boot_cor_BD_rep[i] - boot_cor_BT_rep[i]
  boot_diff_BT_DT_rep[i] <- boot_cor_BT_rep[i] - boot_cor_DT_rep[i]
}

quantile(boot_diff_BD_DT_rep, c(0.025, 0.975))
quantile(boot_diff_BD_BT_rep, c(0.025, 0.975))
quantile(boot_diff_BT_DT_rep, c(0.025, 0.975))

```

## Correlations Including Non-Modelable Trials

```{r}

df.e1_buildtask_somfullset <- df.e1_buildtask |>
  filter(!grepl("35_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("36_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("32_Stability", trial)) |>
  select(id, trial, build_time, easy_hard) |>
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(build_time) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_build = mean(build_time), .groups = "drop")

df.e1_time_somfullset <- df.e1_time |>
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(sd(rating) != 0) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(trial != "37_Practice") |>
  select(id, trial, rating, easy_hard) %>%
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(rating) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_time = mean(rating), .groups = "drop")

df.e1_difficulty_somfullset <- df.e1_difficulty |>
  filter(!grepl("35_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("36_Distance", trial)) |>
  select(id, trial, rating, easy_hard) %>%
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(rating) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_diff = mean(rating), .groups = "drop")

df.e1_somfullset <- full_join(df.e1_buildtask_somfullset,
          full_join(df.e1_time_somfullset, df.e1_difficulty_somfullset))

cor.test(df.e1_somfullset$mean_build, df.e1_somfullset$mean_diff)
cor.test(df.e1_somfullset$mean_build, df.e1_somfullset$mean_time)
cor.test(df.e1_somfullset$mean_diff, df.e1_somfullset$mean_time)

```

## Age Curves by Sample

```{r}

e2b_trial_order <- c("Number1", "Number2", "Number3", "Number4", "Stability",
                     "Number&Stability", "Process1", "Process2", "Pattern",
                     "Probability", "Agent1", "Agent2", "Agent3")

df.e2b_by_sample <- df.e2b_online |>
  mutate(sample = if_else(age_group == "3-5",
                          "Online, Younger (3-5 years)",
                          "Online, Older (6-8 years)"),
         sample = factor(sample, levels = c("Online, Younger (3-5 years)",
                                            "Online, Older (6-8 years)")),
         trial = factor(trial, levels = e2b_trial_order))

df.e2b_younger <- filter(df.e2b_by_sample, age_group == "3-5")
df.e2b_older <- filter(df.e2b_by_sample, age_group == "6-8")

model_e2b_age_younger <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + age + question_type + trial:age +
                                 (1|id),
      data = df.e2b_younger, family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

model_e2b_age_older <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + age + question_type + trial:age +
                               (1|id),
      data = df.e2b_older, family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

df.e2b_age_by_sample <- bind_rows(
  "Online, Younger (3-5 years)" = ggemmeans(model_e2b_age_younger,
      terms = list(age = seq(ceiling(min(df.e2b_younger$age) * 100) / 100,
                             floor(max(df.e2b_younger$age) * 100) / 100,
                             by = .01),
                   trial = e2b_trial_order)) |>
    as_tibble(),
  "Online, Older (6-8 years)" = ggemmeans(model_e2b_age_older,
      terms = list(age = seq(ceiling(min(df.e2b_older$age) * 100) / 100,
                             floor(max(df.e2b_older$age) * 100) / 100,
                             by = .01),
                   trial = e2b_trial_order)) |>
    as_tibble(),
  .id = "sample") |>
  transmute(sample = factor(sample, levels = levels(df.e2b_by_sample$sample)),
            age = x, trial = factor(group, levels = e2b_trial_order),
            predicted, conf.low, conf.high)

df.e2b_success_by_sample <- df.e2b_age_by_sample |>
  group_by(sample, trial) |>
  summarise(min_age = if (any(conf.low > .5)) min(age[conf.low > .5]) else NA,
            youngest = min(age),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = case_when(is.na(min_age) ~ "n.s.",
                           min_age == youngest ~ "all ages",
                           .default = sprintf("%.2f", min_age)))

df.e2b_success_by_sample |>
  select(sample, trial, label) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = label) |>
  kable()

```

# Experiment 3: Additional Analyses

## Rock/Leaf Task

```{r}

df.e3_rockleaf <- read.csv(here("data", "e3_rockleaf.csv"))

# one row per child
df.e3_rockleaf |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n(),
                   n_girls = sum(Gender == "F"), n_boys = sum(Gender == "M"),
                   mean_age = mean(Age), sd_age = sd(Age),
                   min_age = min(Age), max_age = max(Age))

# the youngest children
df.e3_rockleaf |>
  filter(Age <= 5) |>
  group_by(Age) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n(), n_correct = sum(correct))

#binomial test
binom.test(x = sum(df.e3_rockleaf$correct),
           n = nrow(df.e3_rockleaf),
           p = .5)

# Logistic regression: `correct` is 0/1
model_e3_rockleaf <- glm(correct ~ Age*Schooling,
    family = "binomial",
    data = df.e3_rockleaf)

model_e3_rockleaf |>
  joint_tests()

```

## Effect of Schooling

```{r}

model_e3_childfc_withschooling <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + age + trial:age + school +
                           (1|id),
                         family = "binomial",
                         control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                                optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)),
      data = df.e3_childfc)

model_e3_childfc_withschooling |>
  joint_tests()

```

# In-Person Sample

## Data

The In-Person sample is SI only, so it is read here rather than in
`e2b.Rmd`. Its trial names are recoded to match the LookIt data.

```{r}

df.e2b_inpersondev_raw <- read.csv(here("data", "e2b_inperson_dev.csv"), header = T)

df.e2b_inpersondev <- df.e2b_inpersondev_raw |>
    mutate(trial = case_when(trial == "Number_TriCir" ~ "Number1",
                           trial == "Number_Cross" ~ "Number2",
                           trial == "Number_Vert" ~ "Number3",
                           trial == "Number_Horz" ~ "Number4",
                           trial == "Vert_Horz" ~ "Stability",
                           trial == "TwoBlock_TenBlock" ~ "Number&Stability",
                           trial == "Init_Horz" ~ "Process1",
                           trial == "Init_Vert" ~ "Process2",
                           trial == "Pattern_NoPattern" ~ "Pattern",
                           trial == "Sampling" ~ "Probability",
                           trial == "Sling_TwoHands" ~ "Agent1",
                           trial == "Adult_Child" ~ "Agent2",
                           trial == "OneAgent_TwoAgent" ~ "Agent3",
                           .default = trial)) |>
  mutate(gender = ifelse(gender == 1, "Female", "Male"))

```

Combining:

```{r}

df.e2b_childfc_combined <- bind_rows(
  df.e2b_online |>
    mutate(dataset = "LookIt") |>
    select(id, age, gender, question_type, trial, correct, dataset),
  df.e2b_inpersondev |>
    mutate(dataset = "In-Person") |>
    select(id, age, gender, question_type, trial, correct, dataset)
) |>
  filter(trial != "TwoPile_Castle")

```

## Sample Description

```{r}

df.e2b_inperson_children <- df.e2b_inpersondev |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(age = mean(age), gender = first(gender),
            n_trials = n(), .groups = "drop")

df.e2b_inperson_children |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_girls = sum(gender == "Female"),
            mean_age = mean(age), sd_age = sd(age),
            min_age = min(age), max_age = max(age),
            # all 14 trials, TwoPile_Castle included
            n_all_trials = sum(n_trials == 14))

# TwoPile_Castle is not in the main analyses; reported on its own, as for
# adults in the Exp. 2a section above
df.e2b_inperson_twopilecastle <- df.e2b_inpersondev |>
  filter(trial == "TwoPile_Castle")

binom.test(sum(df.e2b_inperson_twopilecastle$correct),
           nrow(df.e2b_inperson_twopilecastle))

```

## In-Person Performance vs. Chance

```{r}

# fit on all 14 in-person trials (TwoPile_Castle included), as model_e2adultfc
# does for adults, so Table S1 can report TwoPile_Castle for both samples
model_e2b_vs_chance_inperson <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type + (1|id),
      data = df.e2b_inpersondev,
      family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

# as_tibble() before any dplyr verb: mutate() on a raw ggeffects object
# silently drops rows
ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_inperson, terms = "trial") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(above_chance = conf.low > .5)

```

## Pooled Samples, Performance vs. Chance

```{r}

model_e2b_vs_chance_younger_pooled <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type + (1|id),
      data = bind_rows(filter(df.e2b_childfc_combined, dataset == "In-Person"),
                       filter(df.e2b_online, age_group == "3-5")),
      family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

# random intercept removed because the model did not converge
model_e2b_vs_chance_all <- glm(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type,
                               family = "binomial",
                               data = df.e2b_childfc_combined)

# In-Person + online 3-5
ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_younger_pooled, terms = "trial") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(above_chance = conf.low > .5)

# All three samples
ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_all, terms = "trial") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(above_chance = conf.low > .5)

```

## Age Curves, All Samples Combined

```{r}

df.e2b_all_samples <- df.e2b_childfc_combined |>
  mutate(trial = factor(trial, levels = e2b_trial_order))

# Same model as model_e2bchildfc_online in e2b.Rmd
# random intercept removed because the model did not converge
model_e2b_age_combined <- glm(correct ~ 1 + trial + age + question_type + trial:age,
                              family = "binomial", data = df.e2b_all_samples)

df.e2b_age_combined <- ggemmeans(model_e2b_age_combined,
    terms = list(age = seq(ceiling(min(df.e2b_all_samples$age) * 100) / 100,
                           floor(max(df.e2b_all_samples$age) * 100) / 100,
                           by = .01),
                 trial = e2b_trial_order)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  transmute(age = x, trial = factor(group, levels = e2b_trial_order),
            predicted, conf.low, conf.high)

df.e2b_success_combined <- df.e2b_age_combined |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  summarise(min_age = if (any(conf.low > .5)) min(age[conf.low > .5]) else NA,
            youngest = min(age),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = case_when(is.na(min_age) ~ "n.s.",
                           min_age == youngest ~ "all ages",
                           .default = sprintf("%.2f", min_age)))

df.e2b_success_combined |>
  select(trial, label) |>
  kable()

```

# Performance by Trial, All Samples

For the latex table in the paper:

```{r}


by_trial_samples <- c("US Adults", "Adults initial", "Adults replication",
                      "Online 6-8", "Online 3-5", "Tsimane'", "In-Person",
                      "Pooled 3-5")

# TwoPile_Castle is a second Stability trial, so its row goes after Stability
by_trial_order <- append(e2b_trial_order, "TwoPile_Castle",
                         after = which(e2b_trial_order == "Stability"))

# Exp. 2a split into its initial and replication samples, same model as
# model_e2adultfc
model_e2adultfc_initial <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type + (1|id),
      data = df.e2adultfc_long, family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

model_e2adultfc_rep <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type + (1|subject_id),
      data = df.e2adultfc_rep_long, family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

df.by_trial_all_samples <- bind_rows(
  "In-Person" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_inperson, terms = "trial")),
  "Online 3-5" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_3to5, terms = "trial")),
  "Online 6-8" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_6to8, terms = "trial")),
  "US Adults" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e2adultfc, terms = "trial")),
  "Adults initial" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e2adultfc_initial, terms = "trial")),
  "Adults replication" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e2adultfc_rep, terms = "trial")),
  "Tsimane'" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e3_childfc, terms = "trial")),
  "Pooled 3-5" = as_tibble(ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_younger_pooled,
                                     terms = "trial")),
  .id = "sample"
) |>
  mutate(trial = as.character(x)) |>
  # TwoPile_Castle was only given to the Exp. 2a initial adults and the
  # in-person children; the other samples show "--" for it
  filter(trial %in% by_trial_order) |>
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = by_trial_samples),
         trial = factor(trial, levels = by_trial_order)) |>
  select(sample, trial, predicted, conf.low, conf.high)

by_trial_n <- c(
  "In-Person" = n_distinct(filter(df.e2b_childfc_combined,
                                  dataset == "In-Person")$id),
  "Online 3-5" = n_distinct(filter(df.e2b_online, age_group == "3-5")$id),
  "Online 6-8" = n_distinct(filter(df.e2b_online, age_group == "6-8")$id),
  "US Adults" = n_distinct(df.e2adultfc_combined_long$id),
  "Adults initial" = n_distinct(df.e2adultfc_long$id),
  "Adults replication" = n_distinct(df.e2adultfc_rep_long$subject_id),
  "Tsimane'" = n_distinct(df.e3_childfc$id),
  "Pooled 3-5" = n_distinct(c(filter(df.e2b_childfc_combined,
                                     dataset == "In-Person")$id,
                              filter(df.e2b_online, age_group == "3-5")$id))
)

df.by_trial_all_samples |>
  mutate(across(c(predicted, conf.low, conf.high), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample,
              values_from = c(predicted, conf.low, conf.high),
              names_glue = "{sample}: {.value}") |>
  arrange(trial) |>
  select(trial, starts_with(by_trial_samples)) |>
  kable()

```

```{r}

by_trial_cells <- df.by_trial_all_samples |>
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", predicted, conf.low, conf.high),
         # "0.72 [0.65, 0.78]" -> ".72 [.65, .78]"; "1.00" is left alone
         cell = str_replace_all(cell, "\\b0\\.", "."),
         cell = if_else(conf.low > .5, cell,
                        paste0("\\textbf{", cell, "}"))) |>
  select(sample, trial, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = cell) |>
  arrange(trial) |>
  select(trial, all_of(by_trial_samples)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(by_trial_samples), ~ replace_na(.x, "--")),
         trial = str_replace_all(as.character(trial), c("&" = "\\\\&", "_" = "\\\\_")))

# in by_trial_samples order
by_trial_header <- c("All adults", "Initial", "Replication", "Online 6--8",
                     "Online 3--5", "Tsimane'", "In-person 3--5",
                     "Online + in-person 3--5")

by_trial_tex <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "\\small",
  "\\label{tab:by_trial}",
  # nine columns: scale the table to the text width
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccccccc}",
  "\\hline",
  # experiment above each sample; Experiment 2a spans all, initial and
  # replication adults, the two online samples share Experiment 2b, and the
  # SI-only in-person and pooled samples are not main-text experiments
  paste0(" & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{Experiment 2a} & ",
         "\\multicolumn{2}{c}{Experiment 2b} & Experiment 3 & ",
         "In-person sample & Pooled sample \\\\"),
  "\\cline{2-4} \\cline{5-6}",
  paste0("Trial & ", paste(by_trial_header, collapse = " & "), " \\\\"),
  paste0(" & ", paste(sprintf("(n = %d)", by_trial_n[by_trial_samples]),
                      collapse = " & "), " \\\\"),
  "\\hline",
  pmap_chr(by_trial_cells, \(...) paste0(paste(c(...), collapse = " & "),
                                         " \\\\")),
  "\\hline",
  "\\end{tabular}%",
  "}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

writeLines(by_trial_tex, here("figs", "table", "som_table_by_trial.tex"))
```

# Modeling

## Model inputs

```{r}

# reset the seed so the bootstrapped CIs in this section don't depend on the
# chunks above
set.seed(42)

df.stability_raw <- read_excel(here("data", "diff_stability.xlsx"),
                               sheet = "diff_stability_x02") |>
  #rename a trial that was left out, regular is LOW here
  mutate(`Friction Level` = if_else(grepl("^57_", `Trial Name`) &
                                      `Friction Level` == "Low",
                                    "Regular", `Friction Level`))

df.ke_raw <- read_excel(here("data", "diff_ke.xlsx"),
                        sheet = "diff_no_phy_ke_20")

```

## Experiment 1

```{r}

df.e1_ke <- df.ke_raw |>
  separate(`Trial Name`, into = c("trial_code", "easy_hard"), sep = "_") |>
  mutate(easy_hard = case_when(easy_hard == "1" ~ "easy",
                               easy_hard == "2" ~ "hard",
                               .default = easy_hard)) |>
  group_by(trial_code, easy_hard) |>
  dplyr::summarise(effort = mean(KE), .groups = "drop")

df.e1_stability <- df.stability_raw |>
  filter(`Friction Level` == "Regular") |>
  separate(`Trial Name`, into = c("trial_code", "easy_hard"), sep = "_") |>
  mutate(easy_hard = case_when(easy_hard == "1" ~ "easy",
                               easy_hard == "2" ~ "hard",
                               .default = easy_hard)) |>
  select(trial_code, easy_hard, risk = Stability)

df.e1_model <- inner_join(df.e1_ke,
                          df.e1_stability,
                          by = c("trial_code", "easy_hard"))

df.e1_model_and_data <- df.e1_combined_forboot_wide |>
  separate(trial, into = c("trial_code", "trial_type", "easy_hard"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
  inner_join(df.e1_model, by = c("trial_code", "easy_hard"))

```

```{r}

model_e1_diff_full <- lm(Difficulty ~ I(effort * (1 - risk)) + I(effort * risk),
                         data = df.e1_model_and_data)

model_e1_diff_effort <- lm(Difficulty ~ effort, data = df.e1_model_and_data)

model_e1_diff_risk <- lm(Difficulty ~ risk, data = df.e1_model_and_data)

summary(model_e1_diff_full)

summary(model_e1_diff_effort)

summary(model_e1_diff_risk)

```

Correlation between each model's fitted values and participants' mean ratings:

```{r}

cor.test(fitted(model_e1_diff_full), df.e1_model_and_data$Difficulty)
cor.test(fitted(model_e1_diff_effort), df.e1_model_and_data$Difficulty)
cor.test(fitted(model_e1_diff_risk), df.e1_model_and_data$Difficulty)

```

```{r}

df.e1_predictors <- df.e1_model_and_data |>
  select(trial, effort, risk)

df.e1_diff_boot_wide <- bind_rows(
  df.e1_difficulty_clean |>
    transmute(id = paste0("orig_", id), trial, easy_hard, rating),
  df.e1_rep_difftime_clean |>
    filter(condition == "diff") |>
    transmute(id = paste0("rep_", id), trial, easy_hard, rating)
) |>
  mutate(trial = paste(trial, easy_hard, sep = "_")) |>
  semi_join(df.e1_model_and_data, by = "trial") |>
  select(id, trial, rating) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trial, values_from = rating)

diff_cor_e1 <- function(data, indices) {
  boot_sample <- data[indices, ]

  boot_means <- boot_sample |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -id,
                 names_to = "trial",
                 values_to = "rating") |>
    group_by(trial) |>
    dplyr::summarize(Difficulty = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(df.e1_predictors, by = "trial")

  cor_full <- cor(fitted(lm(Difficulty ~ I(effort * (1 - risk)) +
                              I(effort * risk), data = boot_means)),
                  boot_means$Difficulty)
  cor_effort <- cor(fitted(lm(Difficulty ~ effort, data = boot_means)),
                    boot_means$Difficulty)
  cor_risk <- cor(fitted(lm(Difficulty ~ risk, data = boot_means)),
                  boot_means$Difficulty)

  c(cor_full, cor_effort, cor_risk,
    cor_full - cor_effort,
    cor_full - cor_risk,
    cor_risk - cor_effort)
}

boot_results_e1 <- boot(
  data = df.e1_diff_boot_wide,
  statistic = diff_cor_e1,
  R = 1000
)

boot_results_e1$t0

quantile(boot_results_e1$t[, 1], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full
quantile(boot_results_e1$t[, 2], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Effort-only
quantile(boot_results_e1$t[, 3], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Risk-only
quantile(boot_results_e1$t[, 4], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full vs. effort-only
quantile(boot_results_e1$t[, 5], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full vs. risk-only
quantile(boot_results_e1$t[, 6], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Risk-only vs. effort-only

```

## Model Predictions (Experiments 2a, 2b and 3)

```{r}

# Simulator trial codes and the canonical trial names they map to
child_model_trials <- c("7"  = "Number1",
                        "15" = "Number2",
                        "8"  = "Number3",
                        "16" = "Number4",
                        "14" = "Stability",
                        "12" = "Number&Stability",
                        "9"  = "Process1",
                        "57" = "Process2",
                        "19" = "Pattern",
                        "13" = "Probability")

df.model_2afc <- df.e1_model |>
  filter(trial_code %in% names(child_model_trials)) |>
  mutate(trial = unname(child_model_trials[trial_code]),
         cost = coef(model_e1_diff_full)[[2]] * effort * (1 - risk) +
                coef(model_e1_diff_full)[[3]] * effort * risk) |>
  select(trial, easy_hard, cost, effort, risk) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = easy_hard,
              values_from = c(cost, effort, risk)) |>
  # difficulty ratio: hard / (easy + hard), or .5 when both are 0
  transmute(trial,
            full = if_else(cost_easy + cost_hard == 0, 0.5,
                           cost_hard / (cost_easy + cost_hard)),
            effort = if_else(effort_easy + effort_hard == 0, 0.5,
                             effort_hard / (effort_easy + effort_hard)),
            risk = if_else(risk_easy + risk_hard == 0, 0.5,
                           risk_hard / (risk_easy + risk_hard)))

df.model_2afc

```

```{r}

df.model_2afc_z <- df.model_2afc |>
  mutate(across(c(full, effort, risk),
                ~ as.numeric(base::scale(.x))))

```

```{r}

# Correlation for each model, plus the three pairwise differences
cor_2afc <- function(data, indices) {
  boot_sample <- data[indices, ]

  boot_means <- boot_sample |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -any_of(c("id", "age")),
                 names_to = "trial",
                 values_to = "correct") |>
    group_by(trial) |>
    dplyr::summarize(mean_correct = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(df.model_2afc, by = "trial")

  cor_full <- cor(boot_means$mean_correct, boot_means$full)
  cor_effort <- cor(boot_means$mean_correct, boot_means$effort)
  cor_risk <- cor(boot_means$mean_correct, boot_means$risk)

  c(cor_full, cor_effort, cor_risk,
    cor_full - cor_effort,
    cor_full - cor_risk,
    cor_risk - cor_effort)
}

```

Does each model's fit improve with age?

```{r}

# Center age once on the full sample, so the centering constant does not
# shift from resample to resample
e2b_age_mean <- mean(df.e2b_2afc_boot_wide$age, na.rm = TRUE)

# Ratio x age interaction for each model, plus the full-vs-lesion contrasts
age_slopes_e2b <- function(data, indices) {
  boot_sample <- data[indices, ]

  d <- boot_sample |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(id, age),
                 names_to = "trial",
                 values_to = "correct") |>
    left_join(df.model_2afc_z, by = "trial") |>
    mutate(age_c = age - e2b_age_mean)

  b_full <- coef(glm(correct ~ full * age_c,
                     family = "binomial", data = d))[["full:age_c"]]
  b_effort <- coef(glm(correct ~ effort * age_c,
                       family = "binomial", data = d))[["effort:age_c"]]
  b_risk <- coef(glm(correct ~ risk * age_c,
                     family = "binomial", data = d))[["risk:age_c"]]

  c(b_full, b_effort, b_risk,
    b_full - b_effort,
    b_full - b_risk)
}

boot_results_e2b_age <- boot(
  data = df.e2b_2afc_boot_wide,
  statistic = age_slopes_e2b,
  R = 1000
)

# Full, Effort-only, Risk-only, then Full vs. effort-only, Full vs. risk-only
boot_results_e2b_age$t0

#compute 95% CIs; if a difference's CI excludes 0, the models reliably differ
quantile(boot_results_e2b_age$t[, 1], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full
quantile(boot_results_e2b_age$t[, 2], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Effort-only
quantile(boot_results_e2b_age$t[, 3], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Risk-only
quantile(boot_results_e2b_age$t[, 4], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full vs. effort-only
quantile(boot_results_e2b_age$t[, 5], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full vs. risk-only

```

```{r}

df.e4_vr_boot_wide <- df.e4_vr |>
  select(id, Friction_Level, Tower_Type, Difficulty) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(id, Friction_Level),
              names_from = Tower_Type,
              values_from = Difficulty)

# Correlation for each model, plus the three pairwise differences
diff_cor_e4 <- function(data, indices) {
  boot_sample <- data[indices, ]

  boot_means <- boot_sample |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(id, Friction_Level),
                 names_to = "Tower_Type",
                 values_to = "Difficulty") |>
    group_by(Tower_Type, Friction_Level) |>
    dplyr::summarize(mean_diff = mean(Difficulty, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(df.e4_model_preds, by = c("Tower_Type", "Friction_Level"))

  cor_full <- cor(boot_means$mean_diff, boot_means$full)
  cor_effort <- cor(boot_means$mean_diff, boot_means$effort_only)
  cor_risk <- cor(boot_means$mean_diff, boot_means$risk_only)

  c(cor_full, cor_effort, cor_risk,
    cor_full - cor_effort,
    cor_full - cor_risk,
    cor_risk - cor_effort)
}

boot_results_e4 <- boot(
  data = df.e4_vr_boot_wide,
  statistic = diff_cor_e4,
  strata = factor(df.e4_vr_boot_wide$Friction_Level),
  R = 1000
)

# Full, Effort-only, Risk-only, then Full vs. effort-only, Full vs. risk-only,
# Risk-only vs. effort-only
boot_results_e4$t0

#compute 95% CIs; if a difference's CI excludes 0, the models reliably differ
quantile(boot_results_e4$t[, 1], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full
quantile(boot_results_e4$t[, 2], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Effort-only
quantile(boot_results_e4$t[, 3], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Risk-only
quantile(boot_results_e4$t[, 4], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full vs. effort-only
quantile(boot_results_e4$t[, 5], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Full vs. risk-only
quantile(boot_results_e4$t[, 6], c(0.025, 0.975)) # Risk-only vs. effort-only
```
